country_decisions: CFG-ADM-001: the public-service law's grades, employment types, leave types and entitlements, personnel actions, performance outcomes and disciplinary outcomes (none ship).

CFG-ADM-002: the approval limits of each institution and the separation-of-duties steps beyond the platform minimum of two officials (lib/casework/dual-control-policy.ts; the country adds steps, never removes them).

CFG-ADM-003: financial rules: budget periods, allowances and reimbursement rates, payroll deductions, procurement methods and thresholds, asset categories and disposal methods (approved, cited rule versions; none ship).
CFG-ADM-004: the records classification scheme and retention schedules (lib/data/retention.ts), approved by the records authority the nation names.
CFG-ADM-005: the institution's ICT systems and privileged roles, and the longest privileged access its security policy allows.

library.title: Approve an internal policy
library.intro: Propose an internal policy: its title, a summary, the text, what it applies to and the provision it rests on. A legal review comes first; two officials approve, neither the one who proposed it.
library.filled_by: The policy owner proposes; the legal service reviews; approving officials decide.
library.authority: The institution itself: each institution adopts the internal-administration procedures as its own (adm.<template>.<institution>) and its own officials decide (caseActRefusal()); never a ministry by name, and an independent institution keeps its own.

policies.access.read_rule: caseReadRefusal() in lib/auth/roles.ts: this institution's own officials (and auditors with a purpose); every read of personal data in the access log
policies.access.others: No other institution reads these records; whole-government officials and administrators get no domain authority

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

Each institution keeps its own internal administration: the form is used in the institution's own procedure (adm.<template>.<institution>), read and decided only by its own officials; whole-government officials and administrators get no domain authority, and an independent institution's records stay with it
deviations.why: Part 21 provides common services without making internal records visible across government.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Who acted: caseActRefusal() / caseReadRefusal() in lib/auth/roles.ts; Constitutional architecture: reaches() and isIndependent()

quotes: Approved plans, indicators, targets, source records, reporting periods and corrective actions

platform.how: Departments are records with the functions they serve (ADMIN_FUNCTIONS), an accountable office, services, staff and history

en.length: Policy title must be 300 characters or fewer.
Summary must be 2000 characters or fewer.

label.en: Departments it applies to (none: the whole institution)

en.reference_exists: There is no record with that reference.

hint.en: Recorded by the platform when the form is received.
